parent_attribution.meaning: declared synthetic projections of one ordinary typed api snapshot; no raw capture, historical fixture or producer is changed

trade.meaning: two declared season teams split two positive-toi appearances and 1,200 reported seconds; the already-published dressed-team references remain fixed
trade.fixed_references: on/off, conversion, penalty and deployment references retain their published values; the browser does not average or reconstruct team references

missing_reported_shifts.meaning: reported shift counts are unavailable in the aggregate and declared team row; positive-toi appearances and reported time remain available

incomplete_personal_credit.meaning: ev personal goals, primary assists, primary points and their rates are unavailable; ev scoring time remains known and independent recorded-goal context remains intact
incomplete_personal_credit.reason: declared synthetic unresolved ev personal credit

goal_context.meaning: the complete on/off recorded-goal body and d07 csv rows are unchanged, apart from explicit team identity metadata in the trade case
